why: Issue #692. The handler builds the path from the raw URL with no resolver at all, as verify.mjs and both uikit scripts did before they served through this module. A raw `GET /../dist-evil/secret.txt` or `GET /../outside.txt` is then answered 200 with a file outside dist, `GET /%` rejects, and `/` names the directory itself and fails its read with 500. The traversal cases drive the handler with the raw URL because a normalising client collapses `..` before sending. Killed by the root, malformed-encoding, sibling-prefix and literal-escape cases; the missing-file case and the listening case pass under it.
killedBy: static-server.mjs: staticHandler serves the root as index.html with its content type
static-server.mjs: staticHandler answers 404 instead of rejecting on malformed percent-encoding
static-server.mjs: staticHandler refuses a sibling directory whose name begins with dist
static-server.mjs: staticHandler refuses a literal .. escape out of dist
